name: Guangdong Feinan Resources Recycling Co., Ltd
summary: Guangdong Feinan Resources Recycling Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the disposal of non-ferrous metal hazardous waste and recycling of renewable resources in China. The company collects and disposes of copper containing industrial solid waste and hazardous waste. It also provides cathode copper, refined nickel sulfate, copper matte, palladium powder, and tin, gold, zinc, and silver ingots. Feinan Resources Recycling Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Foshan, China.
